$comment: The source of sf-file-upload's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/file-upload (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/file-upload/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

link-text.summary: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Click to upload" in English).

formats.summary: Formats line shown under the action. When not set it is derived from accept, and is empty when neither is given: the component names no formats it cannot know.

supporting-text.summary: Supporting line; falls back to formats.

items.summary: The files and their uploads, written by the host: each entry's state (process, done, error) and progress 0-100 is its stream (§10.8)

change.summary: Files were chosen: the native event from the inner file input for a pick, and a CustomEvent from the area for a drop (detail files and source 'drop'), so a form hears of both.

attach.summary: Files were selected for upload. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:select follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

attached.summary: A file entered the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-add follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

detach.summary: A file was removed from the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:remove follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rejected.summary: Dropped files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:reject follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

retry.summary: A failed file was retried. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:retry follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

begun.summary: An entry entered process -- chosen, dropped or retried: its upload stream began (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §10.8, vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.2).

chunk.summary: The host moved an entry's progress while it is in process: {id, done, total} with total 100 (§10.8).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

completed.summary: A file finished uploading. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.summary: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

failed.summary: A file failed. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-error follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

cancelled.summary: An entry left while in process -- removed by the person or by the host: its stream ended without completing (§10.8).

finished.summary: Every file finished. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

remove-item.summary: Remove the item at this index from the list; an index outside the list does nothing. Returns the element.

clear.summary: Empty the list. Returns the element.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim

rows.summary: Files were selected for upload. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rows.note: the detail adds id; the old fields are all there

rows.note: the end of the stream; the detail adds id, reason and message

Every file finished. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-finished with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

x-summary: A drop area that opens the platform file dialog or takes dropped files, filtered by accept, and lists each file with its upload progress, an error with a retry, and removal. The host uploads; the component shows the state the host sets.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.sf-file-upload-retry → retry (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)

lang runtime also holds the words of FILE_UPLOAD_ITEM_TEXT (ui-source/src/component/file-upload/js/_file_upload.js): a shared script this component draws with (§11: no word lives only inside a bundle)
settings.text: its default words move to lang/en.json runtime.text (§11, §16 item 44)
x-decisions: alias-conflict: vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1 decides -- the colon names follow attach, attached, detach, rejected, retry, completed, failed and finished; stand 18's planned hyphen names (sf-file-upload-select, -file-add, …) never shipped and get no alias
completed, not uploaded: vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1 names the end of an upload stream completed (§5.2, standard §10.8); 1.1.2 had planned -uploaded

streams (§10.8): each entry is a stream keyed by its id -- begun when it enters process (a choice, a drop, a retry), chunk {done, total} when the host moves its progress, then exactly one of completed (done), failed {reason, message} (error) or cancelled (removed while in process); finished when every entry is done
version: 1.1.0 -- eight events take their vocabulary names behind dated aliases, and begun, chunk and cancelled are added; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10)
key-effects: Enter and Space on the area open the platform file dialog
setter: items is a writable list setting (§4.4: no set-<name> action, no rule calls it); setItems stays a method of the class outside the interface
item-shape: id, name, file-size, progress, state, error-message, retry-text, file
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json and the docs
css-variables: seven public variables read by the class sheet with the role as fallback, the dragged-over pair among them (§6)
form: none -- the area uploads nothing and submits nothing; the host uploads each file and writes items back (its x-summary)
actions answer outcomes (§4.4): remove-item {index} and clear are applied, or refused no-item / unchanged
host-states: data-dragged-over while files are held over the area (§5.3); the class component keeps its .dragover class

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-upload for local file selection and item-state presentation. Consumer code owns transport and server validation. Shared root-class/style/root-style customize the drop zone, not the adjacent file list; cosmetic renders preserve item File objects. afterRender(callback) uses the base registration API.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: The enabled drop zone is the picker focus owner; nested file actions retain native activation. Use focus-visible and a real forced-colors outline. Disabled controls leave the tab order; re-enabling restores authored tabindex.
